nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.stage0_convert
==========================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.stage0_convert

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   PESA-Fat stage 0 (shared): per-subject DICOM -> NIfTI conversion and renaming.

   Port of :code:`BioImaging/src/pesa_fat/ct_pet/0_conversion_and_organization.sh`.

   Responsibilities (applied to a single ``PESA*`` subject at a time):

   1. Invoke :func:`nvitk.io.conversors.dcm2nii.dcm2nii` with the flags the
      legacy shell script used (``--force-ras --multifile --naming
      Modality_SeriesNumber``). The call produces
      ``NIFTI_ROOT/<batch>/<SUBJECT>/`` with files named
      ``<Modality>_<SeriesNumber>[_<suffix>].nii[.gz]``.
   2. Rename the per-subject NIfTI files into the canonical stage-0 layout:

         * ``CT_<series>.nii``           -> ``CT.nii``
         * ``PT_<series>.nii``           -> ``PT.nii``
         * ``MR_<series>_<metric>.nii``  -> ``DIXON_<REGION>_<metric>.nii``
           (region from DICOM slice location: lowest→HEAD, middle→THORAX, highest→LEGS)

   The script is idempotent: converted subject folders that already contain
   NIfTI files are skipped; already-renamed targets are kept (``Path.replace`` is
   only invoked when the destination does not yet exist).

   Runnable as a standalone CLI
   (``python -m nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.stage0_convert --batch X --subject PESA001``)
   and importable as :func:`run_subject` by the batch master.

.. py:data:: log

.. py:class:: RenameResult

   Outcome of :func:`_plan_rename` for a single file.


   .. py:attribute:: src
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: dst
      :type:  pathlib.Path | None


   .. py:attribute:: reason
      :type:  str


.. py:function:: _plan_rename(src: pathlib.Path, *, series_region_map: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> RenameResult

   Decide the target filename for a converted DICOM-to-NIfTI *src*: normalize CT/PT files, and for
   MR files resolve the Dixon region from *series_region_map* to build ``DIXON_<region>_<suffix>``;
   returns a no-rename result if the naming convention or series mapping is unrecognized.


.. py:function:: _iter_nifti_files(folder: pathlib.Path) -> Iterable[pathlib.Path]

   Sorted list of ``.nii``/``.nii.gz`` files directly under *folder* (empty if it doesn't exist).


.. py:function:: _mr_series_numbers_from_folder(folder: pathlib.Path) -> set[str]

   Distinct MR series numbers parsed from ``MR_<series>_<suffix>`` NIfTI filenames in *folder*.


.. py:function:: rename_subject_folder(folder: pathlib.Path, *, dicom_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None) -> dict[str, int]

   Apply the stage-0 rename policy to every NIfTI file in ``folder``.


.. py:function:: _subject_has_nifti_outputs(folder: pathlib.Path) -> bool

   True if *folder* exists and directly contains at least one ``.nii``/``.nii.gz`` file.


.. py:function:: run_subject(subject: str, lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, *, naming: str = 'Modality_SeriesNumber', force_ras: bool = True, skip_existing: bool = True, compress: bool = True) -> pathlib.Path

   Run stage 0 for a single PESA* subject.

   Returns the subject NIfTI directory (created if missing). Raises
   :class:`FileNotFoundError` if the DICOM subject directory does not exist.


.. py:function:: run_batch(batch: str, *, dicom_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, nifti_root: pathlib.Path | str | None = None, subjects: list[str] | None = None, naming: str = 'Modality_SeriesNumber', force_ras: bool = True, skip_existing: bool = True, compress: bool = True) -> nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout

   Run stage 0 for every PESA* subject in ``batch`` (local / sequential).

   Convert and re-organise a PESA-Fat DICOM batch (single-subject or full batch).
